title: Atlas 1.1 — Reviewer Registry
description: Derived, regenerable view: registry/person_registry.json entries whose roles include REVIEWER. Never hand-edited; regenerate with tools/generate_reviewer_registry.py. This is WHO could review (identities); PROTOCOL.md section 9's actual review requests are tracked separately in pipelines/reviewer-pipeline.json (PR #6) — the two are not merged into one file so that identity data and request/disposition data don't share a single source of truth.
